title: History, Heritage and Museums
summary: أهم كلمات Unit 3 (Echoes of the Past): معبد الكرنك، المتحف المصري الكبير، التاريخ اللي بينتشر على السوشيال ميديا، وتوثيق الاكتشافات — بالمعنى والعيلة والأضداد وتدريب زي Consolidation Review B.

blocks.text: الدرس ده عن إيه؟

text: This page collects the key vocabulary of **Unit 3: Echoes of the Past**: sites of memory such as Karnak, the Grand Egyptian Museum, viral history and how social media documents historical events.

blocks.text: الوحدة دي عن **التاريخ والتراث**: إزاي الأماكن الأثرية بتحفظ ذاكرة الشعب، وإزاي المتحف «بيحكي حكاية»، وليه البوستات التاريخية اللي بتنتشر بسرعة مش دايمًا صح.

الكلمات هنا جاية من نصوص الوحدة ومربعات الـ Vocabulary الأربعة بتاعتها. ومعاها عيلة الكلمة والمرادفات والأضداد، لأن **Consolidation Review B** بتسأل فيهم كتير (زي preservation و accuracy و accessible).

في الكتاب: **Book 1 · Unit 3** (صفحة 74-101). الدروس: **3.1** Sites of Memory (Vocabulary صفحة 79)، **3.2** The Museum as a Storyteller (Vocabulary صفحة 85)، **3.3** The Viral Past (Vocabulary صفحة 91)، و**3.4** Social Media and Historical Events (Key Concepts صفحة 95 و Vocabulary صفحة 97). خلي بالك: الكتاب بيكتب **artifact** (الهجاء الأمريكي)، والهجاء البريطاني **artefact**، والاتنين صح.
إزاي تذاكر الكلمات دي؟

text: Do not just memorise a list. Learn each word with its **meaning**, its **form** (noun, verb, adjective, adverb), the words that go **with** it, and its **opposite**.

items: اقرا الكلمة والمعنى بالإنجليزي البسيط الأول، وبعدين المعنى بالعربي. الامتحان بيسألك بالإنجليزي، فلازم تفهم الشرح الإنجليزي.
بص على **المثال** وحاول تقول جملة شبهه من دماغك عن حياتك.
اعرف الكلمة دي **اسم ولا فعل ولا صفة**. ده بالظبط اللي بيتسأل فيه في «Complete with the correct form».
احفظ مع كل كلمة **عكسها** و**مرادفها**. المراجعات في الكتاب بتسأل «antonymous meaning» و«could meaningfully replace».
ارجع للكلمات بعد يوم، وبعد 3 أيام، وبعد أسبوع. التكرار ده أحسن من إنك تقعد ساعتين مرة واحدة.

blocks.text: Lesson 3.1 — Sites of Memory
الدرس ده عن **معبد الكرنك** في الأقصر وإزاي الأماكن الأثرية بتحفظ الهوية والتراث.

rows: a place that people connect with important events and shared memories
Karnak is a **site of memory** for all Egyptians.
a large old building or statue that is important in history
the history, traditions and buildings passed down from the past
to protect something from damage or loss
who a person or a nation is
a developed society with its own culture and way of life
Egypt has one of the oldest **civilisations**.
built up or collected over time
Karnak is a landscape of **accumulated** memory.
a person who speaks or acts for others
The pharaoh was seen as the gods' **representative** on earth.
written or carved into a surface
Names are **inscribed** on the temple walls.
changed into signs or symbols to carry meaning
متحوّل لرموز ليها معنى / متشفّر / متشفّر
strong love and care for someone or something
The temple shows the people's **devotion** to their gods.
an ancient Egyptian statue with a lion's body and a ram's head
An avenue of **ram-headed sphinxes** leads to Karnak.

blocks.text: Lesson 3.2 — The Museum as a Storyteller
الدرس ده عن **المتحف المصري الكبير (GEM)** اللي اتفتح للجمهور في 4 نوفمبر 2025، وإزاي المتحف بيختار هيحكي إيه.

rows: an object made or used by people in the past
a person who looks after and organises a museum's collection
choosing and arranging objects to tell a story
a series of rulers from the same family
The journey moves through the great **dynasties**.
protecting cultural or natural things from damage
easy for everyone to reach, use or understand
arranged in the order in which events happened
Visitors get a **breathtaking** introduction to history.
to repair something so it looks as it did before
a public show of objects or art
a story or an account of events
Every museum tells a **narrative** about the past.

blocks.text: Lesson 3.3 — The Viral Past
الدرس ده عن البوستات التاريخية اللي بتنتشر بسرعة (go viral) وليه الانتشار مش معناه إن المعلومة صح.

rows: to spread very fast and widely online
A fake photo of Alexandria **went viral**.
the ability to read and judge media content critically
a statement that something is true
The post makes a false **claim** about the pyramids.
to check that something is true or correct
Always **verify** a post before sharing it.
being correct and free from mistakes
always, in the same way over time
Research **consistently** shows that emotion spreads fast.
things that are more important than others
Accuracy is not one of the platforms' **priorities**.
to change something so it is no longer accurate
Myths can **distort** our understanding of history.
a story or belief that is not true
It is a **myth** that fifty engineers built the pyramid.
made bigger or more important than it really is
a happy but sad feeling when you think about the past

blocks.text: Lesson 3.4 — Social Media and Historical Events
الدرس ده عن **توثيق** الأحداث والاكتشافات الأثرية، والفرق بين السوشيال ميديا والتوثيق العلمي.

rows: to make a lasting record of something
Citizens now **document** events with their phones.
recording and keeping information or evidence
digging to discover old objects or buildings
very unusual or surprising in a positive way
covered by or hidden under water
Divers explored a **submerged** city near Alexandria.
news reported by ordinary people, not trained journalists
**Citizen journalism** is fast but not always reliable.
happening and shared at the same moment
historical materials stored and available online
A **digital archive** keeps old photos safe.
choosing which details to show or hide to shape opinion
عرض جزء من الصورة بس لتوجيه الرأي
a person or group that controls what information is shared
الجهة اللي بتتحكم في نشر المعلومة
Historians used to be the official **gatekeepers**.

blocks.title: حيلة للحفظ
items: اعمل **كارت** لكل كلمة: الكلمة على وش، والمعنى والمثال وعكسها على الضهر.
قسّم الكلمات زي ما الكتاب مقسمها (درس درس)، لأن كل درس ليه موضوع وده بيسهّل الربط.
استخدم 3 كلمات جديدة كل يوم في جملة عن نفسك، حتى لو جملة بسيطة.

blocks.text: عيلة الكلمة (Word Families)

text: **Word families** are groups of words that come from the same root but are different parts of speech: noun, verb, adjective and adverb.

blocks.text: مراجعة **Review B** بتطلب منك تحوّل كلمات زي preserve و accurate و access لأشكال تانية. الجدول ده فيه عيلات كلمات الوحدة:
إزاي تعرف تختار الشكل الصح؟ **بص على الكلمة اللي قبل الفراغ واللي بعده**:

rows: بعد a / an / the / my / this أو بعد صفة
بعد الفاعل، أو بعد to، أو بعد can / should / must
قبل الاسم، أو بعد is / are / become / feel / seem
بيوصف فعل أو صفة (إزاي؟ قد إيه؟)، وغالبًا آخره -ly

blocks.text: كلمات بتيجي مع بعض (Collocations)

text: A **collocation** is two or more words that are often used together, like **take responsibility** or **raise awareness**. Using them makes your English sound natural.

blocks.text: الـ collocation يعني «كلمات متجوزة»: بتمشي مع بعض دايمًا. مثلًا بنقول **take** responsibility مش **do** responsibility. لو حفظتهم كده كتلة واحدة، كتابتك هتبقى أقوى وهتعرف تكمّل الفراغات بسرعة.

rows: The GEM **opened its doors to the public** in 2025.
The video **went viral** in a few hours.
**An archaeological discovery** was made in Luxor.
Images are often shared **out of context**.

blocks.text: Prefixes و Suffixes في الوحدة

text: A **prefix** comes at the start of a word and changes its meaning (un- + realistic = unrealistic). A **suffix** comes at the end and often changes the part of speech (aware + -ness = awareness).

blocks.text: الـ **prefix** حتة بتتحط **في أول** الكلمة وبتغيّر **معناها** (غالبًا بتقلبها للعكس). الـ **suffix** حتة بتتحط **في آخر** الكلمة وبتغيّر **نوعها** (من صفة لاسم، أو من اسم لصفة…). دي أسهل طريقة تعرف بيها نوع الكلمة من غير ما تكون حافظها.
مرادفات وأضداد (Synonyms & Antonyms)

text: A **synonym** has the same or a similar meaning (fragile = delicate). An **antonym** has the opposite meaning (mindful ≠ careless).

blocks.text: المراجعات في الكتاب بتسأل سؤالين مشهورين: «The underlined word has an **antonymous** meaning to…» يعني **عكسها** إيه، و«Find the word in the text that could **meaningfully replace**…» يعني **مرادفها** إيه من القطعة. الجدول ده بيجهزك للاتنين.

rows: easy to reach / open to all

blocks.text: كلمات بتتلخبط في بعض

items.en: a **historic** day (important in history) · a **historical** novel (about history)
items.ar: **historic** = حاجة مهمة جدًا في التاريخ، و**historical** = ليها علاقة بالتاريخ. الاتنين صفات.

items.en: Museums **preserve** history. · The **preservation** of history matters.
items.ar: preserve فعل، preservation اسم. بعد The ... of بييجي الاسم.

items.en: Check the **accuracy** of the post. · The post is **accurate**.
items.ar: accuracy اسم بعد the، و accurate صفة بعد is.

items.en: The museum is **accessible**. · Visitors have **access** to guides.
items.ar: accessible صفة (سهل الوصول له)، و access اسم (إمكانية الوصول). وبنقول access **to**.
نفس الكلمة بهجاءين. الكتاب بيستخدم artifact.

items.en: The pharaoh was a **representative** of the gods. · Pharaohs **represented** power.
items.ar: representative اسم (ممثل) أو صفة، و represent فعل (يمثّل).

blocks.text: الكلمات في فقرة واحدة
اقرا الفقرة دي وطلّع الكلمات الجديدة اللي عليها **bold**. حاول تفهم كل كلمة من الجملة اللي حواليها (meaning in context).

text: Egypt's **heritage** is not only kept in books. **Massive monuments** such as Karnak and **remarkable** museums such as the Grand Egyptian Museum **preserve** our **collective memory** and our **national identity**. Inside the GEM, **curators** arrange thousands of **artifacts** in **chronological** order, so visitors can follow the great **dynasties** step by step. **Multilingual** labels make the experience **accessible** to everyone, while **conservation** experts **restore fragile** objects for **future generations**.

Today, however, history also lives on social media. A photo of an **excavation** or a **submerged** city can **go viral** in a few hours. Some of these posts are **exaggerated** or shared **out of context**, and they can **distort** the past. That is why **media literacy** matters: before we share, we should **verify** the source and check its **accuracy**.

blocks.text: المعنى ببساطة: تراث مصر محفوظ في آثار ضخمة زي الكرنك ومتاحف زي المتحف المصري الكبير. أمناء المتحف بيرتبوا القطع حسب الزمن، والخبراء بيرمموا القطع الهشة. بس النهارده التاريخ كمان على السوشيال ميديا، وفيه بوستات مبالغ فيها بتشوه الحقيقة، علشان كده لازم **نتأكد قبل ما نشير**.

blocks.title: أشهر الأخطاء (غلط ← صح)
items: Museums play a role in the **preserve** of heritage. ← in the **preservation** of heritage.
Check the **accurate** of the post. ← Check the **accuracy** of the post.
The exhibition is more **access** now. ← more **accessible** now.
The statues are in **chronology** order. ← in **chronological** order.
The video went **virus**. ← The video went **viral**.
The museum **opened its doors for** the public. ← **opened its doors to** the public.
The papyrus is **fragile**, so it is very **strong**. ← The papyrus is **fragile**, so it is **easily damaged**. (fragile = هش)

blocks.title: إزاي تجاوب في الامتحان
items: Review B بتجيب نص وتقولك «Find the word that could meaningfully replace»: الكلمات اللي في السؤال بتكون **شرح** زي «keeper of the collection» = **curator**، و«time-ordered» = **chronological**، و«ruling families» = **dynasties**. احفظ الشرح الإنجليزي لكل كلمة.
لو الاختيارات كلها صفات معناها قريب، ارجع للجملة. مثلًا fragile «closest in meaning to» = **delicate** مش strong.
الكلمات اللي آخرها **-ation** غالبًا أسماء، و **-al / -able** غالبًا صفات، و **-ly** ظروف. ده بيساعدك تختار بسرعة.
في T/F عن المتاحف: خلي بالك من الكلمات المطلقة زي **every** و **always** و **random**. غالبًا الجملة اللي فيها كده بتكون False.

blocks.text: إزاي بييجي في الأسئلة؟
الأسئلة في الكتاب والمراجعات (Consolidation Reviews) بتيجي بالأشكال دي. شوف إزاي نحل كل نوع خطوة بخطوة:
**النوع 1: Meaning in context**

text:
Before posting the old map, Adel **verified** its date with a historian. What does verified mean in this context?
a. hid it  b. checked that it was correct  c. coloured it  d. sold it

blocks.text: **الإجابة: b**. «مع مؤرخ» قبل ما ينشر، يبقى أكيد **اتأكد** إنه صح.
**النوع 2: Complete with the correct form**

text: The new ramps have made the museum more ______ to wheelchair users. (access)

blocks.text: **الإجابة: accessible**. بعد **more** وقبل to، ومع made + شيء + صفة، يبقى محتاجين **صفة**.
**النوع 3: Closest in meaning / antonym**

text:
"The **colossal** statue welcomes visitors." The underlined word is closest in meaning to:
a. tiny  b. fragile  c. huge  d. modern

blocks.text: **الإجابة: c. huge**. colossal و massive و huge نفس المعنى. (a) عكسها.
تدريب
حل الأول في كشكول، وبعدين دوس **Show answer** وشوف الإجابة والسبب.
**A. Choose the correct answer from a, b, c or d.**

items.q:
1. A person who looks after and organises the objects in a museum is a ______.
a. dynasty  b. curator  c. gatekeeper  d. pharaoh

2. Divers found ancient columns lying under the sea near Alexandria. The columns were ______.
a. inscribed  b. submerged  c. accumulated  d. accessible

3. A post showed only one small part of a photo to make people angry. This is an example of ______.
a. selective framing  b. conservation  c. curation  d. excavation
items.a: **a. selective framing** — بيختار تفاصيل معينة علشان يوجّه الرأي.

items.q:
4. "Fake posts can **distort** our understanding of the past." Distort means ______.
a. explain clearly  b. change so it is no longer accurate  c. record for the first time  d. translate

5. The digging that uncovered the tomb took three years. Another word for this digging is ______.
a. exhibition  b. excavation  c. documentation  d. restoration

6. Ordinary people who film and share news with their phones are practising ______.
a. citizen journalism  b. curation  c. nostalgia  d. heritage

blocks.text: **B. Complete the sentences using the correct form of the word in brackets.**

items.q: 7. The ______ of the Rosetta Stone helped experts understand hieroglyphs. (interpret)
8. Many viral posts about the pyramids are completely ______. (accurate)
items.a: **inaccurate** — المعنى محتاج العكس، والمكان بعد are صفة.

items.q: 9. Archaeologists ______ the site carefully for many months. (excavation)
items.a: **excavated** — محتاجين فعل في الماضي بعد الفاعل.

items.q: 10. The objects are displayed ______, from prehistory to the Roman period. (chronology)
items.a: **chronologically** — بيوصف الفعل are displayed يبقى ظرف.

items.q: 11. Karnak is one of the most ______ sites in Egypt. (history)
items.a: **historic** — مكان مهم جدًا في التاريخ. (historical كمان مقبولة)

items.q: 12. Some old papyri are ______ and need special care. (fragility)
13. The opening of the GEM was a ______ moment for Egypt. (memory)
items.a: **memorable** — قبل الاسم moment صفة = لا يُنسى.

blocks.text: **C. Read the text, then find words in the text.**

text: Last winter, a team of Egyptian archaeologists working in the Delta made an extraordinary discovery: a huge stone gate that had been hidden under the sand for over two thousand years. Within hours, a short video of the find had spread across social media. Some posts added exaggerated claims about hidden gold. Experts reminded the public that every detail must be checked before it is shared, and that the most important thing is to protect the site from damage so that it lasts for future generations.

items.q: 14. Find a word that means **remarkable**.
15. Find a word that means **massive**.
16. Find a word that means **verified**.
17. Find a word that means **preserve**.
18. Find the antonym of **revealed / shown**.
items.a: **hidden** — (had been hidden under the sand) يعني مستخبي.

items.q: 19. Find the antonym of **accurate / balanced**.

blocks.text: **D. Choose the antonym / the correct word.**

items.q:
20. "The papyrus is **fragile**." The underlined word has an antonymous meaning to:
a. delicate  b. weak  c. sturdy  d. thin
items.a: **c. sturdy** — قوي ومتين. الباقي قريبين من fragile.

items.q:
21. "Instagram stories are **temporary**." The antonym of temporary is:
a. short  b. permanent  c. quick  d. digital

22. "This source is **reliable**." The antonym is:
a. trustworthy  b. accurate  c. unreliable  d. official
23. Choose the correct word: The GEM is a (historic / historical) achievement for Egypt.
24. Choose the correct word: The guide spoke to visitors in four languages. He is (multilingual / chronological).

blocks.title: ملخص الدرس في سطرين
items: 3.1: **massive, accumulated, representative, inscribed, encoded, devotion, ram-headed sphinx** · 3.2: **artifact, curator, dynasties, conservation, accessible, chronological, multilingual**.
3.3: **media literacy, significant, claims, priorities, consistently, verify** · 3.4: **excavation, remarkable, submerged, documentation, fragile, accuracy**.
عيلات Review B: **preserve → preservation**، **accurate → accuracy / inaccurate**، **access → accessible**، **chronology → chronological**.
أضداد ومرادفات: fragile = delicate ≠ sturdy · massive = colossal ≠ tiny · reliable ≠ unreliable · temporary ≠ permanent.
قبل ما تشير بوست تاريخي: **verify** المصدر، وخلي بالك من الـ **exaggerated claims** والـ **selective framing**.
